title: Provider quota exhaustion blocked cheap-model delegation
summary: During the bootstrap the Claude subscription session limit stopped three Claude subagents (HTTP 429, reset 7:10pm ET) and the ChatGPT/Codex usage limit blocked gpt-6-luna (reset 9:12pm ET). Adapters classify it as `quota` and the engine fails over, but reset times are not captured, there is no quota-aware scheduling or deferral queue, so cheap routes silently disappear and work shifts to pricier routes.
